product.name: Quickchat AI Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for building, customizing, and deploying AI-powered conversational agents tailored to enterprise needs via no-code tools and API integration.

product.name: Knowledge Base Management
product.description: A system to organize and feed structured enterprise data into AI Agents to improve accuracy and relevance of AI responses.

product.name: Conversation Design Module
product.description: A tool to customize AI Agents' conversational tone, style, and response behavior to align with a company's brand identity.

product.name: Insights Module
product.description: An analytics tool that extracts actionable intelligence from AI conversations, including sentiment, trends, and knowledge gaps.

product.name: Actions Module
product.description: A feature enabling AI Agents to perform automated tasks and trigger workflows directly from conversational interactions.
